responsibility: Render memory search query input, loading/empty/error states, balanced-canvas results with feedback buttons, and low-confidence banner (US-RET-001/006, US-FBK-001/003, US-SRC-005)

outputs.visibleContent: Search result cards with title, source, time, similarity
outputs.accessibilityTree: Cards as combined accessibility elements with type/description/time

fallbackConditions: Available width cannot fit two 152pt cards plus gutter
Long text cards are the majority or exceed summary policy
Critical media cannot be safely cropped
